verdict.rationale: Kimi documents that the assistant can take uploaded files and answer questions about them, and its files API lists image understanding as an upload purpose. A community note confirms vision input exists, though it cannot take public image URLs. Accurate interpretation of screenshots and photos in the consumer assistant is only implied, not shown. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on image/screenshot sharing in the assistant app, independent or hands-on evidence of interpretation accuracy.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them

citations.quote: The Kimi intelligent assistant can upload files and answer questions based on those files.
for text content extraction, image understanding, or video understanding
